name: Work Permit (Employer-Sponsored)

requirements.blocker_text: The employer, through an attorney holding power of attorney, submits immigration documents to the Ministry of Labour before the foreign employee travels to Iraq. Iraqi law caps foreign staff at 50% of an incorporated company's total workforce -- the other 50% must be Iraqi nationals -- though no separate labor-market test (e.g. a specific vacancy-advertising requirement) is described beyond this quota. Once the Ministry approves, the attorney obtains the entry visa from the Directorate of Residence Affairs; after the employee arrives, the attorney must submit the actual work-permit request to the Ministry of Labour within 7 days. The permit is valid 1 year, renewable annually on request at least 1 month before expiry. Exemptions apply to international-organization staff, diplomats, government appointees, and short assignments under 30 working days.
requirements.fix_path: Have the employer's attorney secure Ministry of Labour approval and a Directorate of Residence Affairs visa before arrival, then file the work-permit request within 7 days of the employee's entry.

evidence_required.document: Power of attorney for the employer's representing attorney
Work-permit request (filed within 7 days of arrival)

sources.title: Al Tamimi & Company (regional law firm) -- work-permit process, 50% foreign-staff cap, 7-day post-arrival filing window, exemptions
